In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a team of four [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[182nd Legion]] undertook a '''mission''' to the planet [[Belgaroth]] to investigate rumors of [[Czerka factory]]'s dealings with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Three clones were killed during the mission, but the last one, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]], completed it.
